equations.curve_equation_template: r(φ)=a+b cosφ,  φ=φ₀+Δφt; 두 끝점을 P₀,P₁에 맞춘 닮음변환
equations.branch_policy: principal acos/atan2 values followed by temporal angle unwrapping
equations.unwrap_policy: successive jumps above pi are shifted by integer multiples of 2*pi
equations.variable_conventions: u in [0,1]: path progress; phi: curve angle; t in [0,T]: seconds; theta1/theta2: joint angles; v=tan(phi) only on a stated branch
equations.regularized_curvature: K_epsilon=int_0^1 (x'*y''-y'*x'')^2/(x'^2+y'^2+epsilon^2)^(5/2) du; same fixed epsilon as source
equations.motor_energy_integral: E_model=W_positive+int_0^T R*(tau1^2+tau2^2)/Kt^2 dt; no regenerative recovery; model estimate
equations.one_joint_reference: For a separate ideal 1R vertical example: tau=I*theta_ddot+m*g*lc*cos(theta); int tau*theta_dot dt=[I*theta_dot^2/2+m*g*lc*sin(theta)]_0^T
equations.corrected_note_curvature: kappa(v)=abs(2*a^2+b^2+3*a*b*v/sqrt(1+v^2))/(a^2+b^2+2*a*b*v/sqrt(1+v^2))^(3/2); only regular points on the chosen branch
equations.native_area: sector area=scale^2*abs([0.5*(a^2+b^2/2)*phi+a*b*sin(phi)+b^2*sin(2*phi)/8] at angular endpoints); extra geometry, not swept robot area or an objective
equations.native_warning: The native pole differs from the robot base; side reflection, rotation, scale and translation must all be retained

metrics.integration_method: E/A/J: adaptive QUADPACK partitions + replayable Gauss-Legendre32; L/K/O: v2 trapezoid
metrics.joint_derivative_method: differential inverse kinematics; exact curve/time derivatives
